column1: # The 10 %-step values below are the Sheely tabulation as it is conventionally reproduced (Segur

column1: # concentration_pct is glycerol mass fraction in water
# viscosity_Pas is dynamic viscosity in pascal-seconds (1 Pa.s = 1000 cP = 1000 mPa.s).
# temp_sensitivity_pct_per_degC is the approximate fractional change of viscosity with temperature near room temperature
column2: computed as 100 * ln(mu_25C / mu_20C) / 5. It is NEGATIVE because viscosity falls as temperature rises
column3: and it is the same for both rows of a given concentration because it characterises the 20-25 C interval.

column1: # Rounding note: 80 % at 20 C is quoted here as 0.0602 Pa.s; some reproductions of the same table list 0.0601 Pa.s.
